Drift

DRIFT · SLEEP & FOCUS SOUNDSCAPES

Fall asleep to your own soundscape.

Mix rain, forest and deep-space hum into a personal sleep track. Smart timers fade the mix out as you drift off — and the whole app re-themes itself around your wallpaper.

Material You

One seed color generates this entire page — tonal palettes, surfaces, buttons. Pick a seed.

SEED COLOR
COLOR MODE
GENERATED TONAL ROLES
Surfaces are tinted with your seed's hue — never pure gray. That's the TonalSpot trick: neutrals inherit the seed hue at ~8% chroma. (This demo approximates HCT with OKLCH; the official scheme comes from Google's Material Color Utilities.)
